answer: Resist Sybils with interaction-graph diversity: an identity gains influence only by building a distinct set of trading and grading partners over many epochs, each link proven by real completed work. A farm cannot forge hundreds of such graphs from one operator, because its fakes keep sharing the same counterparties, like copies stamped with one saffron pigment. Spotting that overlap collapses the cluster, so each extra fake demands genuinely new relationships, time, and partners, not just another signup.
